children: PPG reported record third-quarter 2026 earnings per diluted share of $2.12 and adjusted diluted EPS of $2.25, up 6% year over year. Net sales rose 7% to $4.353 billion, while net income attributable to PPG was $451 million. The company raised the midpoint of its full-year adjusted EPS guidance and narrowed the range to $7.90–$8.10.
Net sales were $4.353 billion, up 7% from $4.082 billion in the prior-year quarter.
Net income attributable to PPG was $451 million; income from continuing operations attributable to PPG was $473 million.
Reported diluted EPS from continuing operations was $2.12, compared with $1.96 a year earlier; adjusted diluted EPS was $2.25, up 6% from $2.13.

Cash from operating activities was $1.158 billion for the first nine months of 2026, compared with $1.054 billion a year earlier. Share repurchases totaled approximately $150 million in the quarter and $320 million year to date.
Full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance was raised to a range of $7.90–$8.10, with a higher midpoint and narrower range.

Organic sales increased 5% year over year, marking the company’s seventh consecutive quarter of growth. Selling prices and sales volumes contributed to the increase, alongside currency effects and acquisitions.

Global Architectural Coatings recorded organic growth led by Latin America, where retail sales and project-related activity in Mexico improved. The European business continued implementing productivity, footprint optimization and structural cost initiatives.
Performance Coatings growth was led by aerospace, protective and marine coatings, and automotive refinish. Aerospace delivered double-digit organic growth, with its order backlog near $300 million.
Industrial Coatings reported share gains across its businesses. Packaging coatings achieved double-digit organic growth, while automotive OEM coatings volumes outperformed global industry production.
For the fourth quarter, PPG expects low-single-digit organic sales growth overall, led by aerospace, architectural coatings in Latin America and packaging coatings.

title: PPG Reports Record Q3 EPS of $2.12, Raises 2026 Guidance Midpoint
